text:
oliver-fin: Heads up 1: vendor price feed schema drift caused two customers to lose their grandfathered pricing during last night's ingest. getting inbound support tickets.

maya-ops: Which customers/invoices?

oliver-fin: INV-2025-06-10-2201, INV-2025-06-10-2202; custs: STARTUP-7, STARTUP-8. Looks like vendor renamed `preserve_legacy` -> `preserve_flag`.

rachel-revops: I'm checking experiment assignment: both customers are still in bucket "keep" per experiment service. so this is ingest-only.

jing-eng: We deployed a new vendor parser that tightened header validation. It currently treats unknown headers as ignorable. I'll scan the raw CSV to confirm the header name change.

maya-ops: Running quick audit query: `SELECT invoice_id, billed_price, preserve_legacy FROM invoices WHERE invoice_id in ('INV-2025-06-10-2201','INV-2025-06-10-2202')`

billing-bot: Query result -> INV-2025-06-10-2201: preserve_legacy=false, billed_price=0.15; INV-2025-06-10-2202: preserve_legacy=false, billed_price=0.15.

jing-eng: Found vendor raw header: `customer_id,plan_code,price_usd,preserve_flag,experiment_bucket`. compatibility mapping didn't include `preserve_flag` alias. Fix incoming.

maya-ops: Proposal: scoped reingest of the two rows from raw vendor file, run dry-run then live. I'll own the backfill. ETA dry-run 30m.

rachel-revops: Also prepare a short external note for affected customers and a CSM FAQ. Keep it concise: cause = vendor column rename, fix applied, credit issued.

sam-legal: Keep wording factual. Remove language that admits fault beyond a simple corrective statement. If refund > $1000 required, escalate to legal.

maya-ops: Dry-run output (snippet):
```
2025-06-11T03:15:01Z INFO -> reading 2 rows from vendor raw file
2025-06-11T03:15:02Z INFO -> row STARTUP-7: preserve_legacy true after alias mapping
2025-06-11T03:15:03Z INFO -> invoice INV-2025-06-10-2201 delta credit $11.20
2025-06-11T03:15:04Z INFO -> row STARTUP-8: preserve_legacy true after alias mapping
2025-06-11T03:15:05Z INFO -> invoice INV-2025-06-10-2202 delta credit $0.00 (promo already applied)
```

maya-ops: Dry-run looks good. planning live reingest + credit apply at 04:00 UTC.

jing-eng: I'm opening a PR to add `preserve_flag` to alias list and to change the parser to emit warnings for unmapped header names. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/price-ingest/pulls/358

rachel-revops: Draft customer message: "We apologize for a temporary billing error caused by a vendor file header change. We've applied an account credit for the difference; no action is needed. Contact billing@redwood.ai for questions." Thoughts?

sam-legal: Please remove "we apologize" -> use "we regret"; include "no change to your subscription terms" clause. Also change contact to billing@redwood.ai and CSM routing.

rachel-revops: Updated message posted to CSM channel; queued to send after credits applied.

maya-ops: Live reingest started at 04:00 UTC. Command: `./tools/reingest --rows 2201,2202`

billing-bot: Action complete: INV-2025-06-10-2201 -> credit $11.20 applied; INV-2025-06-10-2202 -> no credit (promo). Status: completed.

oliver-fin: Thanks team. Jing: please merge the alias PR and add an import-report rule that fails the ingest if critical headers are absent for two consecutive imports. Maya: add a line to the pricing-rollout checklist to validate header aliases with the vendor for the next three imports. I'll draft a short postmortem and assign owners.
